summary: The live preview renders the prior English labels as “로컬 워크벤치” and “워크벤치 · 합성 미리보기.” Copy and spacing remain readable at all five widths, with no horizontal overflow. The ToolCall summary has no border, its success badge is 24px tall, and the preview retains a 1px boundary. The preview is Korean-language and keyboard-inert; no browser errors were recorded. Loading, error, and malformed-result fallback copy was inspected in source.
limits: Live review used only a synthetic fixture. Loading, error, and malformed-result states were inspected in source rather than reproduced visually. Real SDK behavior, dark mode, 200% zoom, and screen-reader output were not tested. The running bundle was not independently attested to the source hash.
